tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rdo rje shugs kyi bsgrub thabs bzhugs//

"$ ༄༅// rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal nas// las dang sngags kyi nges pa bshad// 'khor lo'i dbus su pad ma la// zla nyi sgra gcan drag po bdud// mnan pa'i haṃ skyes khro bo che// gnam sngon lta bu'i lus po la// g.yas dmar g.yon dkar dbus nag zhal// rgyab zhal gser 'dra mgrin gsum pa// dpung par bcas pa'i phyag gnyis ljang*// khrag bcas glang po'i lpags pa 'dzin// lhag ma dus kyi 'khor lo 'dra// sna tshogs yum gyis mgul nas 'khyud// dpal gyi chas kyi rab tu 'bar// nyi ma bye ba'i gzi dang ldan// de ltar bdag nyid snyems byas nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal bskyed/ oṃ ham̐ kro ta ham̐ kro ta nam̐ adzña dha ya kā swa hā/ de nas phyag rgya dgod de/ oṃ haṃ hāḥ bha ma dha kṣi ṇi/ kā rna yoḥ badzra kun dha li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ aḥka ru kā na thāe/ badzra me kha lāe/ badzra ka ṇa the kāe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ a aḥbā ma dha kṣi nā ka ra yor badzra ru tsa ko'u hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha hāḥbā ma dha kṣi na ban dha yor badzra nu pu re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ hāḥbam̐ pan tsa a ka ra ma ha shu n+ya sa bha bā ma ha badzra shi ro ma ṇi shi ra si sarba a ge brarma hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ oṃ a dha na ri sha rā badzra an dha tsan tra badzra pad ṭo u dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ a āḥ sarba sa ḍa e ka tri sa ra sa bha bā badzra ya dzo pa pī ta kan dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes phyag rgya drug go /de nas glang lpags la sogs pa phyag rgya gzhan bzhi ni/ oṃ kṣaḥ dhur dhan tan bhi ma na kṣa yi kar bhya ghra tsa rmā ka ṭu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ kṣa tri shad swa ra sa pa ta ti hra sa dhi rga bya dza na swa bha be dhe'i dya ku la sha ta shi ra bhi rmyun dha ma lāe ska dha a laṃ bh-i ni skan dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha hi hri hū hli pan tsa ska dha/ bhi shud dha so bhya be shi ra si ka pa la ma le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/

oṃ kṣa kṣā kshī kshī kshar kshirā kshu kshū kshil kshilā ksho kshā/ ha hā hi hī hri hrī hu hū hli hlī haṃ hāḥ sarba bhi ga nā bhi dha ri da ga tsa tsa rma pa ram̐ ṭa/ ra ga ta shra sa ta hū phreṃ/ mgo g.yas su bstan la sdig 'dzub dang bcas pas 'dzin pa'o// phyag rgya bcu'o// de nas phyag gi mtshon cha rnams kyi sa bon ni/ oṃ ksha kro ta badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kshā badzra khar ge hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kshā tri shu la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kshā badzra kar ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kṣa badzra bā ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kshā badzra a gū sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kshā badzra dha ma ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kshā badzra mud ka ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kshā badzra tsag kra hūm̐ phaṭa/ o kṣā badzra kun dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kshā badzra dan da hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kshā badzra par shu hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa ni g.yas su mtshon cha dgod pa'o// oṃ ham̐ badzra ghan ḍa ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badzra khe ta ka ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badzra khwa ṭwām̐ ga ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badzra ka pā la ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badzra pa tsa la ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badzra pa sha ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badzra rad na ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badzra pad ma ho phreṃng phaṭa/ oṃ badzra sham̐ kha ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badzra dhar sa ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badzra shri kha la ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ tsa tu pe ta mu kha pa dbā bā bhra ma shi ra ho phreṃ phaṭa/ ces g.yon gyi mtshon cha'o// de nas klu bcu dgod de/ oṃ hūm̐ badzra dza ya nā gā ṇa ra badzra dza ṭa mu ku tra bhan dha tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ a ྐ shyu badzra bī dza ya na gen dhra badzra pa da bhan dhe tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ hra hrā badzra kar ko ta badzra pad ma ba ma de khyi na kun dha la yo tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ hraṃ hrā badzra ba su ki shaṃ kha ba lo ba ma dha kṣi na ru tsa ka tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ hram̐ hrā badzra a nan ta ku li ka me kha la ka ṇa thi kā yo tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/

oṃ hli hlī badzra ḍa kṣa ki ma ha pad mo ba ma da kṣi ṇa pa da nu bu re yo tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ de ltar sngags dang phyag rgya bkod// bgegs rnams thams cad tshar bcad cing*// bka' bsgo bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom/ 'phrin las bsgrub na bzlas pa bya// de nas rkang pa bcu drug pa mkha' 'gro ma dra ba dang ldan pa cig la/ gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'i sngags 'di lta ste/ oṃ na mo badzra pa ta yā/ na mo bhud dha bāo dhe sa twa bhya/ na mo badzra kro ten tra ra dze bhyo/ na mo bi sha ma tre/ na mo bhud dha bo dhi swa twa de bi bhyo/ na mo badzra dha ki ni bhyo/ oṃ na mo bha ba ba te kā la tsaka kra ya/ badzra bāai ra ba bhi ka ra yā/ ma hen tra ni la rba rba sha ra yā/ ma ra ke kle sha hri da yā tran ta sha ta ra ga ta tsha ra na yā/ kri shna ra ga ta shi ta kan ṭhra yā/ ni la si ta pi ta/ ra ga te/ dam̐ ṣṭha ka ra le a ta/ bhi sha na mu kha yā/ kri shna ra ka ta si ta pam̐ bhe ta ra kan dha yā/ ha hu da sha bhu dzā yā/ ṣa ṭa bi shad ti ka ra yā/ badzra kha rgam̐ tri shu la/ ka ti ka ba ṇa/ a ghu sha ḍa ma ru ka/ mud ka ra/ tsa kra kun dha/ dhan dha pa ra shu/ badzra ghan dha/ khe ṭa ka kha ṭam̐ ga ka pa la/ tsa pā/ pa sha/ ra na/ ka ma la shaṃ kha ar dhar sha pri kha la/ rba ma shi ro/ ga dza ya rma dhyi ta ka ra ya/ bha ghra tshar ma ba sa na yā/ shan dhe mu ḍa ma la a ba laṃ bhi ne/ shi ra pri badzra pa tra mu ku te/ badzra ka pa la mā la a dha tsan tra dha ra yā/ kun dha la/ ru tsa ka/ kan thī ka/ me khā lā/ nu bu ra/ bha sma/ ya dzo pa bi ta/ shi ro ma ṇi/ ma ha mu tra nā gen ta/ bi bu sha na yā/ badzra dha ki ni/ san to shi ta hri ta ya yā/ in tra/ ag ne/ ya ma/ ni ri tya/ ba ru ṇa/ ba yu/ ku be ra/ i sha ra/ bra rma/ bi shṇa bī na yā/ kar ti ke yā/ nan ti/ ma hā ka lā/ ghra hā/ na kṣa tra kṣe ṭu pa la/ su ren tra/ a su ren tra/ pha nin tra/ bhun ten tra/ na ren tra/ sam̐ stu ta/ ra tsa nā yā/

zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis sngags rkang pa bcu drug po 'di bye ba bzlas pas las thams cad grub bo// dngos grub chen po brgyad ni/ sbyin bsreg 'bum phrag bcus 'grub bo// sngon du bsnyen pa'i nges pa'o// de nas klags pa tsam gyis las thams cad byed do// bcom ldan 'das kyi phreng ba'i sngags so so'i yan lag brjod de/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ kṣa ma la ba ra yā/ ha kā la tsatra/ dur dan ta/ dha na mā ka/ dzā ti dzā ra ma/ ra na a nan ta ka/ hro lo kya bi dza yā/ ma ha bi re sha ram̐/ badzra bhe ra ba/ badzra ka yā/ badzra gā tra/ badzra ne ra/ badzra so tra/ badzra gha ṇa/ badzra dzi ba/ badzra dan ti/ badzra na ga badzra ka sha/ badzra lo ma/ badzra a bha ra na/ badzra ha sa/ badzra gi ta/ badzra n+yir dya/ badzra yu dha ka ra/ badzra kro dha ka ra dza/ ati pa ti/ badzra dha ka/ badzra dha ki ni dzā lā pa ri bri ta/ shri gham̐ a ghad tsha/ badzra sa ta adzña ye sarba mā rā bhi gha nā bi na yā ka ki na ra ki phu ru ṣa/ gha ru ṭa/ ghan dhar dbhe/ ya kṣa/ rakṣa sya/ bhu ta/ ma hā pre ta/ ku sman dha/ a pa sma ra/ kṣe pra pa la/ ba twang ṭa/ pū ta na du ṭu na ga gra ha/ da yo ye sarba dza ra sarba/ bhya dhyi/ shni tri ba tra pa kā ri ṇa/ sarba sa twa nam̐ sarba a pa ka ra tā nan dza/ shwi ghram̐ badzra a ghu shā nā kri ṣu ur dha dhe shi ga tā nā kri shya kri shya/ pur rba di shi gā tā nām̐ kri shya kri shya/ u da ra di shi ga tā nā kri shya kri shya/ pas tsi ma de shi ga ta nā kri shyā kri shya/ bha ya bha re shi ga ta nā kri shya kri shya/ ir sha na deng shi ga ta nā kri kṣu kri kṣu/ ni re dhi shi ga tā nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ ag na ya de shi ga tā nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ a ta de shi ga tā nā kri shya kri shya/ a kasha maṇa dha la ga ta nā kri ṣya kri ṣya/ ba yu man dha la ga tā nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ te dzo man dha la ga dha nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ u ta ka man dha la ga tra nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ pri thi bi man da la ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/

ka ma dha tu ka ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ ru pa dha tu ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ a ru pa dha tu ga ta nā kri ṣu kra ṣu/ ka ya dha tu ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ bag dha tu ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ tsid ta dha tu ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ pañtsa skan dha ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ pañtsa dha du gha ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ pañtsi in tre ya ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ pañtsa bī sha ya ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ pañtsa karma in hre ya ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ pañtsa karma wi sha ya ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ sarba to ya tra ku tra tsa twa nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ ma ha sma sha ṇi/ badzra ag ni dzwa li ta bu myaṃ ni pa ta yā pa ta yā/ badzra pa she na sarba bhu dzi shu bhan dha yā bhan dha yā/ badzra pring kha la yā sarba bad de shu ni ro dha ni ro yā/ sarba sa te ṣu ka yā bag tshid do pa tra pa tra ra tan tā na ma ho na tan na/ ma ha kro dha badzra tsu rna pa yā/ tsur rna pa yā/ badzra kha rga na ni trin ta yā ni trin ta yā ni/ badzra kri shu len bhe da yā bhe da yā/ badzra kar ti kā pa ha nā ha na/ badzra ba ṇe na bhin dha bhin dha/ badzra ki la kāe ki la yā/ badzra mud ka ra na a ko ṭa yā a ko ṭa yā/ badzra tsag kra na tshe dha yā tshe dha yā/ badzra kun dhe na bin dha yā bin dha yā/ badzra dan dha na ta ṭā yā ta ṭā yā/ badzra par shu na tsi dha ya tsi dha yā/ sa dha tri kro ṭi khan tro kir ta so sha na bhu ma/ sarba bhu ta bhyo/ bha li ma ku ru ku ru/ badzra dharma ru gā na badzra dha ka ni rā bha ha yā bha hā yā/ badzra dha ki ni bhyo mā rā ka yi nam̐/ ru dhi ram̐ ni bhe dha ya ni bhe dha ya ni/ pan tsa armi ta ni be dha ya ni bhe dha yā/ sarba badzra dha ki ni sa hi taḥ sarba sa twa nam̐ shan ting ka phuo ṣṭi kam̐ rakṣa ba ra nam̐ gu pa ta ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ phreng sngags yan lag bcas pa 'di// bdud dang 'byung po'i gnod pa rnams/ lan bdun gyis ni bzlog par byed// sngon du bzlas pa bye ba byas// de yi bcu cha sbyin bsreg ste// so so'i las la 'bum phrag bcu// sbyin bsreg 'bum phrag gis 'grub 'gyur// phyi rol zla ba bcu gnyis la// 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis phye zla// nang du g.yas g.yon 'pho ba'i rlung*// dkyil 'khor drug cu'i bzlas pa yin// gzhan yang lha rnams kun gyi sngags// sku yi rdo rje spangs nas ni// dang por gnas pa'i yi ge rigs// dbyangs dang gsal byed gang yin pa// rang ming 'byung ba'i bye brag gis// dbyangs yig sgra gyur srog 'phrog cing*// gsal byed sgrar bsgyur nad bsogs byed// btang snyoms byed pas yun rings 'gyang*// mdza' bor gyur pa yon tan 'thob// sa rlung dgrar gshed me chu sgra// sa chu mdza' bo rlung me snyoms// me rlung mdza' bos sa chu snyoms// yi ge so so'i 'byung ba ni// dbyangs 'char nas ni bshad pa bzhin// nam mkha' ye shes kun gyi grogs// gzhan yang sngags kyi bsgyur byed ni// nam mkhas bsnun cing rlung gis 'bebs// me yis bsreg cing chu yis tshim// sa yis dgyes shing ye shes kyis// ro mnyam byed pa'i sngags rig bya// 'di ni rgyal bas sngon bstan to// gang rgyud sde so sor las gsungs pa'i lha la sogs pa rnams kyang rung ste/

chu yig las skyes pa'i lha dkar po pad ma'i phyag mtshan can sngags na ma'i mtha' rten dang bcas pa ni zhi ba'o// de nyid la cung zad ser ba dang bcas pa rab tu dgyes shing rgyas pa'i lus can swa hā'i mtha' can rgyas pa 'grub bo// me yi yig ge las skyes pa kha dog dmar ba dang rab tu dmar ba sgeg cing chags pa'i rnam pa can lcags kyu dang mda' dang rin po che la sogs pa 'dzin pa bhau ṣa ṭā dang ba shad tra dang*/ hri dza la sogs pa'i mtha' can gyis dbang dang dgug pa'i las 'grub bo// sa'i yi ge las byung ba mdog ser ba dang rab tu ser ba brjid cing brtan pa'i gzugs can lcags sgrog dang 'khor lo phur bu la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pa staṃ bha dang mo ha ya dang laṃ nan la sogs pa'i mtha' can rigs pa dang rmongs pa dang mnan pa dang phur bus gdab pa 'grub bo// rlung gi yi ge las byung ba nag cing 'jigs pa'i gzugs can ral gri dang gri gug g.yo ba'i mtshan ma 'dzin pa ma ra ya phaṭa dang u tsa ta ya sogs pa'i mtha' ni gsad pa dang bskrad pa 'grub bo// nam mkha' dang ye shes kyi las byung ba rnam pa kun dang ldan pa'i sna tshogs mdog can dang nam mkha' lta bu de nyid kyi sngags dang ldan pa gso ba dang las thams cad pa byed do// phreng ba yang zhi ba la shel/ bskrad pa la mu tig bsad pa la mi rus/ bskrad pa la bong bu'i rus pa/ dbang la bo dhe tse/ dgug pa la pad ma'am tsan dan dmar po/ rmongs pa la lung thang*/ rengs pa la ru rag sha'o// de bzhin du 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga yang*/ zhing sa rgyas la n+ya tro ta'i 'dab ma la bsil ba dang ldan pa'i bsnyug gus snod khab phor du da ra ba nu ma dang bcas te zla bas bskol ba dang glang po che'o// bsad bskrad la ro ras la dug khrag gis bya rog gi sgros bris te thod par yi dwags dang rnga mo la'o// dbang dgug la gro ba la gur gum dang ghi haṃ gis gser gyi smyug gu ste/

pra tshil dang bcas pa'i ri dwags dang rta'i lus la'o/ rengs pa dang rmongs pa a ka'i 'dab ma la ba sla dang bcas pa'i snyug gus so phag dang bcas pa ra lug gam rus sbal gyi lus la'o// srad bu yang so so'i kha dog go// mdor na rgya chen bstan mod kyi// 'dir ni nyer 'kho bsdus pa yin// ro langs bya khyung bsgrub pa dang*// ral gri mig sman ri lu dang*// char dbab la sogs 'phrin las rnams// so sor bsgrub par bya ba'am// rdo rje'i shugs kyi bde blags bsgrub// las dang sngags dang lha so so'i// nges pa bstan pa rang byung rdo rje yis sbyar ba'o// sems can thams cad kyis mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob par gyur cig// /
